name: @pipeworx/mcp-openholidays

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Public (statutory) holidays for a European country in a date range, with regional subdivisions. EUROPE-focused (~30 countries: DE, FR, NL, CH, IT, AT, BE, ES, PL, etc.). Returns each holiday with its localized name, dates, whether it is nationwide, and which subdivisions observe it. Keyless. For school terms/breaks use school_holidays instead.

tools.name: school_holidays
tools.description: School holidays (term breaks: Christmas, Easter, summer, etc.) for a European country in a date range, optionally scoped to one subdivision. This is the unique value-add over worldwide public-holiday sources — school calendars vary by region. EUROPE-focused (~30 countries). Returns each break with its localized name, dates, and observing subdivisions. Keyless.

subdivision_code.description: Optional subdivision/region code to filter to, e.g. "DE-BY" (Bavaria). Use list_subdivisions to discover codes.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the ~30 European countries OpenHolidays covers, with their ISO codes and official languages. EUROPE-focused. Keyless.

tools.name: list_subdivisions
tools.description: List the regional subdivisions (federal states, regions, cantons, etc.) of a European country, with their codes and category. Use the returned codes to scope school_holidays. EUROPE-focused. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openholidays forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openholidays pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
